title: A smooth (n−1)-form on ℝⁿ whose exterior derivative is a given partial derivative
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, a : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ smooth (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a) and j ∈ Fin (m+1). Then there is a smooth m-form ψ on ℝ^{m+1} (IsSmoothForm ψ) with tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a such that dψ(x)(e₀, …, e_m) = ∂ⱼa(x) := Da(x)eⱼ for every x ∈ ℝ^{m+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → ∃ ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m, IsSmoothForm ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a ∧ ∀ x : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative ψ x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))
